item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "8fb4722129a3ae268986955b3e780aa25fcd8623eaade35494d610f49dd8dc19",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For every real x and every real t > 0, q(x,t) = q(x/t,1).",
      "effect_on_target": "The self-similarity hypothesis implies q(0,t) = q(0,1) for every positive t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef004 applied to evolutionEquation, leftState, rightState, and q.",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces the conjunction of the arbitrary evolution predicate and the specified initial data conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The value LocalDef005(q)(0), which is q(0,1).",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side of the equivalence is exactly q(0,1) = value.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The conjunction of evolutionEquation(q) and LocalDef006 applied to the function x ↦ q(x,0) and the two designated states.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both the evolution predicate and the negative-axis and positive-axis initial data equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "The function assigning to each real ray the value q(ray,1).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the profile by evaluation at time 1; its value at zero is the state appearing in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For a function data from the reals to State, the conjunction that data(x) = leftState for every x < 0 and data(x) = rightState for every x > 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires q(x,0) = leftState for x < 0 and q(x,0) = rightState for x > 0, without imposing a value at x = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality between two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All state comparisons are exact equalities, including the self-similarity and initial data conditions and both sides of the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence of two propositions, requiring implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts both that q(0,1) = value implies every positive-time value at zero equals value and that the latter condition implies q(0,1) = value.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "The binary strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the real strict order to restrict times to t > 0 and initial spatial coordinates to x < 0 or x > 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "The value representing a natural-number numeral in a type through its OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numerals as real constants zero and one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both coordinates of q and the profile parameter range over the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict-order instance on the reals, with relation Real.lt.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the inequalities in the hypotheses and conclusion ordinary strict real inequalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero instance on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real zero used as spatial coordinate, initial time, and comparison threshold.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Builds the numeral-zero instance from a type's designated zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the real numeral 0 denotes the zero supplied by Real.instZero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a DivInvMonoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real division operation used in x/t in the self-similarity condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "The division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the quotient x/t in the normalized spatial coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Builds the numeral-one instance from a type's designated one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the profile's reference time 1 as the real multiplicative identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative structure with inversion and division, including the law that division equals multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real division for x/t. Its other operations impose no additional hypotheses on State or q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.instOne",
      "meaning": "The one instance on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the fixed real reference time 1 in q(x/t,1) and q(0,1).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Converts a division operation on a type into a homogeneous HDiv operation on that same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes x/t an ordinary real quotient with a real result.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both component propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the evolution predicate together with the initial data condition, and requires both sides of the initial data condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify an arbitrary type State in universe u_1, with no specified algebraic, order, topological, or analytic structure.",
      "Universally quantify a predicate evolutionEquation on functions from R × R to State.",
      "Universally quantify leftState and rightState in State.",
      "Universally quantify a function q: R × R → State, represented in curried form with spatial coordinate first and time coordinate second.",
      "After the two hypotheses, universally quantify value in State.",
      "The self-similarity condition universally quantifies x in R and t in R subject to t > 0; the initial data conditions universally quantify x in R subject to the indicated sign; the right side of the conclusion universally quantifies t in R subject to t > 0."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "evolutionEquation(q) holds.",
      "For every real x < 0, q(x,0) = leftState.",
      "For every real x > 0, q(x,0) = rightState.",
      "For every real x and every real t > 0, q(x,t) = q(x/t,1)."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "For every value in State, q(0,1) = value if and only if q(0,t) = value for every real t > 0."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "The profile associated with q is the function P: R → State given by P(r) = q(r,1).",
      "The distinguished state in the conclusion is P(0) = q(0,1).",
      "Self-similarity means the pointwise identity q(x,t) = P(x/t) for every real x and positive real t.",
      "The initial data condition prescribes leftState on the strictly negative spatial half-line and rightState on the strictly positive spatial half-line at time zero."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For any type State, any predicate evolutionEquation on real-space, real-time State-valued functions, any states leftState and rightState, and any function q, suppose evolutionEquation(q) holds, q(x,0) equals leftState for every x < 0 and rightState for every x > 0, and q(x,t) = q(x/t,1) for every real x and positive real t. Then, for every state value, the profile value q(0,1) equals value if and only if q(0,t) equals value at every positive real time t."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "Self-similarity and the conclusion concern strictly positive times only. They do not impose corresponding identities at time zero or at negative times.",
    "The initial data condition does not prescribe q(0,0).",
    "The function q is defined for all real spatial coordinates and all real times, even though the explicit conditions constrain only selected parts of that domain.",
    "evolutionEquation is an arbitrary predicate. No particular differential equation, solution concept, regularity, conservation law, or admissibility condition is specified.",
    "The conclusion follows from self-similarity alone; the evolution predicate and the initial data hypotheses are not needed for this equivalence.",
    "The positive-time universal condition is not vacuous because it includes t = 1. The quotient in the self-similarity hypothesis is only used with a positive, hence nonzero, denominator.",
    "The assertion is conditional and does not establish existence of q satisfying the hypotheses. If those hypotheses are unsatisfiable for a chosen predicate and states, the corresponding implication is vacuous.",
    "State may be empty as a quantified type, but then there are no choices of leftState, rightState, or value, so that instance has no instantiated claim.",
    "leftState and rightState need not be distinct, and no equality between the distinguished state and either of them is asserted.",
    "All equalities are pointwise exact equalities. No limiting trace, continuity at time zero, almost-everywhere interpretation, or uniqueness of an evolution is encoded.",
    "There are no existential witnesses or witness dependencies in the proposition."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
